config.visibleores.title: Visible Ores
config.visibleores.enabled.tooltip: When off, the mod does not change any texture.
config.visibleores.ore.enabled.tooltip: Turns the alternate texture of this ore on or off.
config.visibleores.dimension.tooltip: Where the alternate texture is used. The End is never affected.
config.visibleores.height_limit.tooltip: When on, the alternate texture is used only between the Y levels below.
config.visibleores.min_y.tooltip: Lowest Y level (inclusive) that uses the alternate texture.
config.visibleores.max_y.tooltip: Highest Y level (inclusive) that uses the alternate texture.
config.visibleores.texture.tooltip:
Standard: flat textures of the Vanilla Tweaks ore pack.
Fancy: animated and emissive textures; connected with Continuity.
Custom: textures from the resource pack chosen below.
config.visibleores.custom_pack.tooltip:
A pack from your resourcepacks folder that replaces this ore's texture.
It is read directly, so does not need to be enabled in the Resource Packs screen.
config.visibleores.blue_debris.tooltip: Uses the blue Netherite texture variants (Standard or Fancy).
config.visibleores.keybinds.master.toolt: Turns all texture changes of the mod on or off.
config.visibleores.keybinds.ore.tooltip: Turns the alternate texture of this ore on or off.
config.visibleores.missing_cloth.message: Install Cloth Config to edit Visible Ores settings in game.
